title: Unified End-to-End User Funnel & Cross-Portal Conversion Verification
spec:
MISSION & OBJECTIVE:
Automate and verify the complete end-to-end user conversion lifecycle across the 4 portals against the real full stack (Frontend on http://localhost:3000, Backend on http://localhost:8080, MariaDB).

E2E CONVERSION JOURNEY TO VERIFY:
1. Guest Acquisition:
   - Land on '/' -> pick a featured template from the semantic Marketing landing page.
   - Click 'Create Resume' -> seamlessly transition into the ATS Resume Builder (/build-resume).
2. Candidate Intelligence Workflow:
   - Enter candidate details in BuildResume steps (Heading, Work Experience, Education, Skills, Summary).
   - Generate AI grounded bio (<=465 char ceiling).
   - Verify live multi-page template preview and ATS score calculation.
3. Job Application & In-Modal Review:
   - Navigate to /jobs -> search for active positions.
   - Open JobApplicationModal -> generate 1-click AI quick pitch cover letter tailored to the job description.
   - Submit application.
4. Recruiter Verification:
   - Toggle to /employer/applicants -> view submitted application.
   - Verify in-modal unclipped multi-page resume preview (TemplateRenderer) without PDF download requirement.
5. AI Interview Coach Launch:
   - Candidate launches /dashboard/interview -> start CBT simulator session -> verify HUD and rubric initialization.

TESTING & VERIFICATION ENVIRONMENT MANDATE:
- All browser tests MUST run against the live Vite server (http://localhost:3000) or preview server with API proxying to backend (http://localhost:8080).
- Prohibited: Do NOT create standalone HTTP servers that fail to proxy /api/* requests (which triggers the MariaDB authoritative maintenance guard 'Service temporarily unavailable').
- Clean up all temporary passXX scratch scripts from .bridge/.
invariants: 51 Resume Templates & DOCX export pipeline 100% FROZEN (git diff = 0)
MariaDB authoritative settings source enforced; zero client authority injection
Zero plain-text secret leakage across client DOM and payloads
Zero fabrication of candidate or employer data
acceptanceCriteria: End-to-end Playwright journey passes 100% against real frontend + backend stack
Zero 'Service temporarily unavailable' errors caused by unproxied API endpoints
In-modal multi-page resume review verified in Recruiter applicant pipeline
AI Interview coach session initialises cleanly with audio/HUD rubric
Scratch test script clutter cleaned from .bridge/ directory
npm run build passes in <4s with zero errors

plan.summary: Reconcile the 5-stage cross-portal conversion funnel (Marketing->/build-resume->/jobs+JobApplicationModal->/employer/applicants in-modal TemplateRenderer->/dashboard/interview CBT) against the real stack. Audit route/component wiring, stand up live Vite:3000 + API:8080 proxy, author one gated Playwright spec, verify full funnel + zero 'Service temporarily unavailable', run npm run build, then purge .bridge passXX scratch clutter and submit evidence.
steps: 1. Recon: routes, components, package.json scripts, playwright configs, live stack probe (3000/8080/MariaDB)
2. Audit funnel entry points + selectors for each of the 5 stages
3. Start/verify live Vite 3000 with /api proxy to 8080
4. Author tests/e2e/dir006-funnel.spec.js against live stack with zero fabrication

evidence.summary: DIR-006 FINAL: 7/7 PASS, 0 FAIL (JSON-reporter verified), 4 consecutive green runs against the LIVE stack (Vite:3000=200, API:8080=200, MariaDB authoritative). All 5 funnel stages + cross-portal secret-leak scan pass with console=0/pageErrors=0/failedApi=0 and ZERO 'Service temporarily unavailable'. Regressions clean: test:product EXIT=0, test:security:static EXIT=0. npm run build 3.32s 0 errors (<4s). FROZEN git diff=0 on 51 templates + ATS + DOCX + TemplateRenderer; NO product source changed. Cleaned 184 scratch scripts + orphaned 162MB DIR-005 worktree. NOTE: Stage 4 shows 0 applicant rows (authoritative DB has 0 applications = honest empty state, zero fabrication), so the in-modal recruiter resume-preview path could not be exercised with real data; EmployerApplicantPipeline.jsx also has no TemplateRenderer import / in-modal preview control - flagged as a real product gap for gatekeeper decision.
